svg.text: Amazon ML Challenge 2026 — Pipeline V4 Architecture
Large-Scale Entity Resolution across 24.2M Records | Official Public Leaderboard Peak:
0.8380 Entity-Level Macro F0.5
1. Multi-National Raw TSV Data Sources (24.2M Records Universe)
• S1 Queries: 1,732,544 test entities | S2 & S3 Targets: 9,970,000 records
• Regions: India (46.8%), US (38.3%), France (15.0% zero-shot domain shift)
2. Multi-National Normalization & Script Transliteration
• Indic Transliteration: Devanagari, Tamil, Telugu ➔ Latin ITRANS (Jaro: 0.00 ➔ 0.68+)
• Domain Word-Segmentation: urbanconstruction.com ➔ urban construction
• Title/Tag Stripping (M/s, Shree, Dr) & French Normalization (SARL, SAS, Rue, Code Postal)
3. 38-Channel Hybrid Super-Blocking Engine (Crushing the Recall Ceiling)
• 18 Inverted Hash Channels: Exact, Transliterated, Suffix-Cleaned, Sorted Tokens
• Locality & Structural Anchors: Plot/Door Regex (109/1, Pl.No.370), State + Name, City + Street Num
• Approximate ANN: Sparse char-wb (3,5) TF-IDF Cosine joining via C++ OpenMP kernels
Global Blocking Recall: 96.64% (US: 97.99%, India: 94.62%) | Ceiling Broken
4. 56-Feature SIMD C++ RapidFuzz Extraction Engine
• Token SIMD: Jaro-Winkler, Levenshtein, Token Sort Ratio, Jaccard, Simpson Overlap
• Subfield Alignment: Exact Postal match, Street number match, City similarity
• Decoupled Dual-Head logic to prevent feature collapse on 30.2% null addresses
5. Dual-Model GBDT Diversity Ensemble (LightGBM + CatBoost GPU)
• LightGBM Booster: Leaf-wise trees with monotonic constraints & precision-weighted loss
• CatBoost GPU: Oblivious symmetric trees for zero-shot generalization on France
• Soft-Voting Blend: P = 0.80 * P_LightGBM + 0.20 * P_CatBoost (70% CatBoost on France)
Streaming Inference: 35k-query chunks | Peak RAM strictly < 9.5 GB
6. Country Thresholds & Strict Precision Gap Guard
• Country-Calibrated Base Cutoffs: US (0.68), India (0.65), France (0.67)
• Strict Gap Guard: If entity_matches >= 2 and prob < (top_prob - 0.16) ➔ INSTANT REJECT
• Protects 5.58% Ground Truth Singletons against the 4x Precision Penalty in F0.5
Precision Preservation: Avoids false positives that drop singleton score from 1.0 to 0.0
7. Greedy Injective Bipartite Matching & Official Submission
• Capacity-Constrained Matching: Enforces 1 target record ➔ at most 1 query entity
• Output Deliverables: matching_results.tsv (1,732,544 rows) & candidate_pairs.tsv
• Fully validated via validate_submission.py with 100% format & constraint compliance
★ Verified Public Leaderboard Score: 0.8380 Macro F0.5 (+0.1360 Over Baseline)
